description: Search the Plugolis directory of MCP servers. All filters are optional; with no arguments it lists every server. Returns name, slug, category, status and a link for each match. Use get_server for install details.

category.description: Category name or slug, e.g. 'Databases' or 'databases'. See list_categories.

client.description: Only servers whose docs mention this client, e.g. 'Cursor', 'Claude Desktop', 'VS Code'

query.description: Words to match against name, description and category, e.g. 'postgres' or 'browser automation'

status.description: 'maintained' = updated in the last 6 months, 'stale' = not

transport.description: 'local' runs on your machine, 'remote' is a hosted URL (servers offering both match either)

name: search_servers
title: Search MCP servers
